summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the completed issuance of USD 1 billion Senior Unsecured Fixed Rate Notes under its USD 7.5 billion Global Medium Term Note Programme. The notes are rated BBB by S&P and Baa3 by Moody's, and will be listed on India International Exchange IFSC, NSE IFSC, and SGX-ST. The offering is not registered in the U.S. and is not a public offer. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, restructuring, or strategic reviews. What to watch: no equity-related event; purely a funding exercise.
